general.openLocalOnStartDescription: Automatically create a local terminal tab when the app launches
general.showPrimaryPanelDescription: Keep the connections and sessions sidebar visible when the app opens
general.showSecondPanelDescription: Keep the info and transfer panel visible when the app opens
general.resetSettingsDescription: Restore all preferences to their default values

appearance.colorThemeDescription: Choose the overall palette for the UI and terminal; theme files can also define corner radius, panel layering, and other chrome. Add custom themes in the themes folder under your Puck config directory
appearance.themeModeDescription: Use light, dark, or system mode with the selected palette
appearance.uiFontFamilyDescription: Font for sidebars, buttons, and dialogs (does not affect the terminal); follows the color theme unless customized
appearance.borderRadiusDescription: Roundness of buttons, cards, inputs, and other controls; follows the color theme unless customized
appearance.windowRadiusDescription: Outer corner radius on macOS transparent windows; set to 0 to disable; follows the color theme unless customized
appearance.shellLayeringDescription: Background contrast between side panels and the main workspace; follows the color theme unless customized
appearance.terminalPaddingDescription: Padding between terminal content and its border (vertical × horizontal, in px); follows the color theme unless customized
appearance.resetUiAppearanceDescription: Some UI chrome values are customized and will not change when you switch color themes

terminal.copyOnSelectDescription: Copy selected text to the clipboard automatically
terminal.scrollbackDescription: Number of lines kept in terminal history (1000–50000)
terminal.defaultPrivilegesDescription: Applied to new terminal sessions; per-session overrides remain available

systemResources.description: Configure how often system stats are collected and which metrics appear in the info panel
systemResources.localPollIntervalDescription: How often to refresh CPU, memory, and other stats on this machine
systemResources.remotePollIntervalDescription: How often to refresh stats on a remote host over SSH
systemResources.metricsDescription: Choose which system metrics to show in the info panel

connections.credentialsDescription: Passwords and key passphrases are stored in the system keychain
connections.credentialsEmpty: No remote connections yet. Create one to store credentials securely.
connections.credentialsDesktopOnly: Credential management is available in the desktop app.
connections.noCredentialsRequired: No stored credentials required for this connection
connections.hostKeysDescription: Trusted SSH host keys for first-connect verification
connections.hostKeysEmpty: No trusted host keys yet. Keys are added when you confirm a new SSH host.
connections.hostKeysDesktopOnly: Host key management is available in the desktop app.

keyboard.title: Shortcuts
keyboard.description: Keyboard shortcuts for the main workspace
